desc: The Incubator (scripts/core/incubator.gd, decision 0080). An egg in a cradle hatches after hatch_secs of play time: time in the garden and time in a match both count, time with the game closed does not. An Ember kin at the brazier and Ember Coals add to the pace.
hatch_secs_doc: Seconds of play an egg needs at the plain pace (20 minutes).
